WHY THE SIGNALS MATTER

The same mistake.
A different next step.

An incorrect answer alone cannot tell us whether the concept was unclear, a prerequisite is missing or a pause would help. RTAE adds session context to that decision.

47PARAMETERS IN THE DESIGN

Facial expressions, eye movement, voice and posture, alongside physiological indicators including heart rate, blood pressure, SpO₂, temperature and stress indicators.

01 / OBSERVE IN CONTEXT

See beyond the answer.

Consider available signals alongside hesitation, requests for help, learning history and the student’s own feedback.

02 / RECOMMEND A RESPONSE

Choose what to change.

RTAE suggests a simpler step, a new example, slower pace, focused practice or a break. The personal planner approves.

03 / CHECK WHAT FOLLOWS

Keep learning from the response.

Specialist modules act on the approved plan. The next response informs whether to continue or adjust.

What this could look like

Repeated errors plus signs of strain may prompt a check-in. If the student confirms difficulty, the planner can approve a simpler example or a pause, then review the next response.

Signal availability depends on consent, supported devices and validated integrations. Physiological estimates are not medical diagnoses. Complete 47-parameter coverage and learning effectiveness require validation.

ONE LEARNER. A CONNECTED SUPPORT SYSTEM.

A personal learning team.
With one shared plan.

The Individual Learning Planner coordinates what, when and how much to study. Specialist modules deliver the learning, and each result informs the next step.

01

Personalised lessons

Different examples, language, style and depth. Approved changes can reshape a lesson during the session.

02

Practice & doubt support

Target learning gaps and work through the point of difficulty. Results feed back into the learning plan.

03

Revision that checks understanding

Quick revision clips, or Teach Me Something: the student teaches the AI, whose questions help surface gaps.

04

Exams & schoolwork

Scheduled assessments and schoolwork inform the next steps in the independent learning journey.

05

MetaLab exploration

Web-based and VR activities connect concepts with practical subject and chapter tasks.

06

Wellbeing & motivation

Focus, memory and stress-buster activities, with animal identities and milestones that make progress tangible.

For your child: a clearer next step. For you: a journey centred on understanding, not just completed chapters.

A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Before you decide.

Do we need a VR headset?+

The planned MetaLab experience includes web-based activities as well as VR experiences. A VR headset is not required for the ordinary web learning journey. The launch activity catalogue will specify device requirements.

When does the introductory month begin?+

It begins when your child’s access is activated, not when you reserve. The planned launch window is December 2026–January 2027. Access is not immediate; exact activation dates and included launch features will be confirmed before paid reservations open.

Is ₹1,399 a monthly price or a six-month payment?+

The offer is ₹1,399 per paid month for the first six paid months after the introductory month. The ₹100 reservation credit reduces the first paid bill to ₹1,299. The planned price thereafter is ₹1,499/month. Billing, tax treatment and cancellation terms will be displayed before checkout.

Can I pay now? What about refunds?+

This is a pre-launch offer for Phase 1, limited to 5,000 students, with launch planned for December 2026–January 2027. Reservations are open. Payment is processed securely by Razorpay on the checkout page, where the full reservation, cancellation and refund terms are shown before you pay.

Are these scientifically proven learning outcomes?+

No learning-outcome guarantee is being made. The approach uses learning evidence to inform decisions, while student effectiveness validation remains ahead. Engagement estimates are contextual signals, not medical diagnoses or a substitute for a child’s own feedback.
